Its 78 km of pistes are ideal for a stay of 3 to 4 days, especially for families or skiers who don't need to keep changing terrain. Technical skiing is king at La Thuile: with 2 black runs and 7 red runs on offer, confident skiers will find plenty to test themselves. Off-piste and freeride are often enjoyed in excellent conditions, thanks to the altitude and the orientation of the slopes. With a summit at 2800 m and a village at 1441 m, snow reliability at La Thuile is generally good from January to the end of March. A few exceptionally mild winters can cause strains early in the season, but the situation recovers quickly once serious snowfall arrives. A stay at La Thuile is clearly expensive: €54 for a day lift pass, plus accommodation and mountain restaurants that are among the most expensive in the Alps. It is the price of excellence, but you should be aware of it before you go. In short: La Thuile keeps its promises. A Northern Alps resort that will suit most skiers without disappointing.
